summary: Ran type checks and tests across @gizmo/agent-server, @gizmo/protocol, and @gizmo/extensions. Protocol and extensions packages pass cleanly; agent-server shows 17 failing tests across 4 files (run-script, extension-resources, pi-runtime-config, session-repository). Then read source for the failing modules, surveyed cross-package import usage, and inspected the websocket transport to scope a refactor plan.
errors: run-script: tests fail with "Script must be inside the workspace" before reaching the assertions about shell rejection, missing scripts, non-zero exits, timeouts, missing bun, large output truncation, and maxBuffer kills — the workspace containment check fires too early.
extension-resources packageResourceRoots/extensionResourceRoots: resolve returns empty arrays for both convention and manifest-declared skills/prompts directories across all five assertions.
pi-runtime-config: written auth.json ends up with mode 0o666 (438) instead of the expected 0o600 (384) in two tests covering missing Pi config import and explicit Pi auth re-import.
session-repository: restored catalog lacks the expected workspacePath/title entries the test asserts via arrayContaining — actual records carry Windows-style paths and "New session" titles.
